docTitle: Nokxer Povitr Pustok · Povitr Pustok eka nodrent
metaDesc: Pornnea Korarachi kall-vôll, Jezuchem jivit, ani Paulucheô bhõvddeô eka khôrea nokxer sôd — Povitr Pustok khôrê zageancher ghoddlem.

s.title: Nokxer Povitr Pustok
s.verse: “Amcho Somi Jezu Krist podven ietolo mhonn ami tumkam xikoilem tedna, dusreamnim hikmotin ghôddlolim gop’pam-talam ami tumkam sangunk nant. Na; ami Tachi thôr mhoima amcheam khaxa dolleamnim dekhlea.” (2 Pedru 1:16)
s.purpose: Povitr Pustok ek dhont-kotha nhoi. Hem khôrê zage, tarkam ani nãvamcher chôllolea mon'xanchem ek lekhonn. Tê vatteô eka nokxer, kallachea kraman sôdun kadd — eka binduk ttôch kôr, vô ▶ dabun pavlan-pavlim chôl.
s.ot_lead: Ek-uch bhõvddi nhoi punn rochnnê thaun soddvonnê-itihasacho vôgllo: rochnnê ani pôddnni → loddi ani Babel → ek ulo (Abraham) → bhasayil'lo dês → Bhair-vôchem → ronn → zoit → raj → vantnni → bondkhonn → portun-ievop.
s.je_lead: Bôrê-Khobream Jezuchem jivit koxem sangtat, tea kraman tem sôdun kadd — Betleamantlea tacha zolma thaun, tacho bautizm ani Galileiacho misanv, Samaria pôlltoddi, Jeruzalemantlea khurs, punorjivontponn ani sôrgar-vôcha meren.
s.pa_h: Antiokia thaun prithumechea koddxam meren — Rom
s.pa_lead: Jeruzalemantlea Pentekosta thaun, bôri khobor Judeia bhair koxi possôrli — Lhan Asia ani Europ pôlltoddi razvôddkechea kallzak. Panch bhõvddeamnitli ek vinch (pôili·dusri·tisri + Roma vôchpachi bhõvddi + suttka uprantli) ani vatter boroil'leam potramnim-sangata Niz-kãmachim ghoddnnê sôd.
s.foot: Mull · Zage Povitr Pustokachea utrank ani sodanchea Povitr Pustokachea bhugola-pormonnem asat (adhunik nãvam adar zata thõi). Doria-kodde, nõieo ani sarovôr ugddea bhugol-mahitê (Natural Earth) thaun kaddlolim, sompim kel'lim.

eden.name: Eden (Rochnnê · Pôddnni)
eden.note: Bhov borem rochlolea sonvsarant, patok bhitôr sôrta ani Dev ani mon'xa modlem bondh moddta.
events: Pôddnni, ani Eden thaun bhair kaddunchem
Pôili bôrê khobrechi bhasavnni — “bailechi xivddi sôrpachem mathem mostounchi”

noah.name: Ararat (Loddi)
noah.note: Dev patkan bhôrlolea sonvsarak nyai kôrta, tôriy eka ghorabea vorvim jivit rakhta.
events: Dhonucho korar — “portun kednanch sonvsar naxtt korunk loddi ieuchi na”

babel.name: Babelacho Buruz
babel.note: Sôrgak pavpachea gôrvak vodhun, Dev tancheô bhaso ani mon'xank prithumecher vixkôlaita.
events: “Ami ek xar ani ek buruz bandhuiam… ani amkam nãv kôruiam”

ur.name: Ur
ur.note: Povitr Pustokachi soddvonnechi kotha eka mon'xachea ulean suru zata.
events: Dev Abramak Kaldeanchea Ur thaun apoita
“Hanv tuka ek vhôddli zaat kôrtolom… sogllim kullam tujê vorvim besãv mellteleô”

haran.name: Haran
haran.note: Vatter, bhasayil'lea desa vatten ulo ghevn.

shechem.name: Xekem · Kanaan
shechem.note: Bhasayil'lea desant ek ghorabo bandta ani korar pillgek pillgi vôta.
events: Kanaanant bhitôr sôrun, pôilo vedi — “ho dês tujê xivddek ditolom”
Jakobache bara put — bara kullancho mull

egypt.name: Egipt (Gôxen)
egypt.note: Ek ghorabo ek vhôddli zaat zata — magir gulamanchi zaat.
events: Duxkall thaun sutunk Jakobacho saglo ghorabo sokoil ieta

sinai.name: Sinai Dongor
sinai.note: Pornnea Korarachem mukhel suttavnnem — gulam Devachi khaxa porza zatat.
events: Tambddo Doria futta ani tim uttrat
Dha adnia, Somurt, Mellnnem-tombu ani bolidanam

kadesh.name: Kades (ronn)
kadesh.note: Ovixvasan ek pillgi dês hôgddaita — tôriy Dev tanchê-sangata ravta.
events: Bara her — punn lôk bhavart tthevunk inkar kôrta
Ronnant 38 vôrsam — manna, megh ani uzo

jericho.name: Jericho
jericho.note: Nimannem tim bhasayil'lea desant bhitôr sôrtat ani to gheutat.

shiloh.name: Xilo (Nyaikartam)
shiloh.note: Koslo-i raza naslo dekhun dôr-eklo apnnak dislolem tem kôrta — ek khoro raza gôrjecho.
events: Rut — kalokhi disamnim visvaxikai, Davidachê vonxant

jerusalem.name: Jeruzalem · Ekttavlolem Raj
jerusalem.note: Israelacho bhangranno iug — ani eka sasnnachea raja-chi bhasavnni.
events: Pôilo raza Saul, magir David ani Goliat

samaria.name: Samaria · Vantlolem Raj
samaria.note: Provade bôbaltana raj vantun vôta ani moddon vôta.
events: Solomona uprant, Juda ani Israel oxem vantun vôta
Elias, Izaias, Jeremias ‘portun ieiat’ mhonn ulo kôrtat — ani Mesiavixim bhakit kôrtat

nineveh.name: Ninve (Aslur)
nineveh.note: Dôr-ek chetavnni durlokxun, Uttôr pôilo poddta.
events: Uttrechem raj Aslurachea hatak poddta (722 PK)

babylon.name: Babilon
babylon.note: Sôglleam kôrdôtti rat — tôriy punorsthapônachi bhasavnni urta.
events: Daniel ani Ezekiel — bondkhonnent bhavart ani dôrxonam

susa.name: Susa (Persia)
susa.note: Ek murti-puzok razvôddkechea gôbheant-i, Dev apli porza rakhta.
events: Nehemia raja mukhar magnnem kôrta ani taka dhaddtat

return.name: Jeruzalemak portun
return.note: Tim portun ietat ani portun bandhtat — punn koslo-i raza ailo na. Tim Mesiachi vatt polleitat.
events: Sirusachea hukman tin lharamnim portun (Zerubabel 538 · Ezra 458 · Nehemia 444)
Mondir portun bandhtat ani Jeruzalemacho gãvkott portun uboita
Malaki — Pornno Korar sompta: “Hanv Mhozo khôbri dhaddtolom”

bethlehem.name: Betleam
bethlehem.note: Bhasayil'lo Mesia Davidachea gãvant ieta — Sôbd monis zalo.

nazareth.name: Nazaret
nazareth.note: Dev ek samanya gãvant monis zaun vhôdd zata.
events: Bara vôrsancho astana, mondirant prôxn ani zap ditalo
Magir apnnachea gãvachea sinagogant ônôll zalo

jordan.name: Jordan Nõi
jordan.note: Tacho lôkani misanv suru zata — sôrg Taka Put mhonn mudra kôrta.
events: Atmo pharvea bhaxen denvta — “Ho Mhozo môgacho Put”

cana.name: Kana
cana.note: Apnnachea pôilea nixannen To apli mhoima ugddi kôrta.
events: Udok soro zalem — tacho pôilo nixanni

sychar.name: Sikar (Samaria)
sychar.note: Suruvatechea misanvachi vatt — Jeruzalem vatten ani ônôll'lolea Samariak.
events: Ratchea, Nikodem — “Tuka portun zolm gheunchoch poddttolo”

capernaum.name: Kafarnaum
capernaum.note: Galileiachea misanvachem mukhel thodd — apovnnem, xikovnn ani virôdh sogllem hangach mell'tat.

galilee.name: Galileiacho Doria
galilee.note: Nisorga-voilea bollan To dakhoita To konn.
events: “Xant rav, gôp rav” — To vaddoll xant kôrta
Panch undde ani don masllen 5,000 mon'xank jevonn dita

caesarea_p.name: Sezaria Filipi
caesarea_p.note: Xis somzotat ki To Krist, ani khursachi vatt ugddi zata.
events: Pedruchi kobulai — “Tum Krist, jivea Devacho Put”
To pôilech pautti apnnachem moronn ani punorjivontponn adim sangta

jericho.name: Jericho
jericho.note: Jeruzalemak choddttolea vatter, To hôgddlolean sôdta.

bethany.name: Betani
bethany.note: Apnnachea nimannea satollea adlea disa To moronna-vôir apli sôtta dakhoita.
events: Lazarak fonddantlo jivo uthoita — “Punorjivontponn ani Jivit Hanvuch”
Maria puronna khatir Taka tel lavta
Ho nixanni Taka marunk ravlolo kôts ghôtt kôrta

jerusalem.name: Jeruzalem
jerusalem.note: Saglem Povitr Pustok zaka-koddem vôta to uchamb — khurs, punorjivontponn, sôrgar-vôchem.
events: Zoiticho praves; To portun mondirachim mez ubaddta
Nimannea Jevnnant To xisanche paim dhuta
Tisrea disa jivo zata, magir sôrgar vôta

antioch.name: Antiokia
antioch.note: Dhaddpi Igorz jõi poriaki-lôkacho misanv suru zata ani portun ieta.
events: Magnnea-modem Atmo Barnaba ani Saulak vengllo kôrta
Igorz jõi bhavartaleank pôilech pautti ‘Kristanv’ mhonn'lem
Pôilê, dusrê ani tisrê bhõvddechem suru-thodd

seleucia.name: Selusia
seleucia.note: Antiokiacho bondôr — tim Sipra khatir tarvar vôtat.

paphos.name: Pafos
paphos.note: Bôrê khobrek virôdh korpeank vodhun boll dakhoitat.

perga.name: Perga
perga.note: Pamfiliantlo ek bondôr — hanga Juanv Marku portun vôta.

pantioch.name: Pisidiachi Antiokia
pantioch.note: Bôri khobor poriaki-lôka vatten ugddi zata.
events: Zaite poriaki lôk sôntôxtat ani Sôbd svikartat

iconium.name: Ikonium
iconium.note: Zaitê bhavart tthevtat, punn chhôll-monnen tankam mukhar dômpta.

lystra.name: Listra
lystra.note: Dev mhonn manlo, magir fatramnim marlo.
events: Zolma thaun longddea eka mon'xak borem kôrta
Lôk tankam dev mhonn bôli diunk polleta
Fatramnim marun mel'lo mhonn soddlo, to utthon uttta

derbe.name: Derbe
derbe.note: Zaite xis kôrtat; Igorzo ghôtt korunk tim porto vatt kôrtat.

troas.name: Troas
troas.note: Zago jõi bôri khobor pôilech pautti Europ vatten vôta.

philippi.name: Filipi
philippi.note: Europachi pôili Igorz — bondxallent-i bôri khobor zoit vhorta.
events: Jãbllea kôpddancho vepar korpi Lidia bhavart tthevta
Modhiratichim bhôjnnam, ek dhôrnnikamp, bondxall-rakhonnaracho ghorabo vanchlo

thess.name: Tesalonika
thess.note: Sôbd xarak halloita ani virôdh uchambta.
events: Tin Xibbot disamnim sinagogant ohvat kôrta

berea.name: Berea
events: Dôr-dis tim topasunk Povitr Xastr vachtat

athens.name: Atens
events: Areopagusar To Rochnnar ani punorjivontponn porgottta

corinth.name: Korint
corinth.note: To dedh vôrsam ravta, ek durgunni xaran ek Igorz lavta.
events: Zaite Korintkar bhavart tthevtat ani bautizm gheutat

ephesus.name: Efez
ephesus.note: Tisrê bhõvddechem kalliz — Sôbd Asia-bhôr possôrta.
events: Tirannachea xallent don vôrsam dôr-dis xikovnn
Ruperkar Demetrius ek gôddbôdd suru kôrta

miletus.name: Miletus
events: “Aplea rogtan Tannem viktem ghetlolê Igorzechi zôgôt gheiat”
Vhôddil roddtat, jannon ki tim Taka portun polleuchim nant

caesarea.name: Sezaria
caesarea.note: Don vôrsam To razpalt ani eka raja mukhar bôrê khobrechi rakhonn kôrta.
events: Razpalt Feliks ani Festusa mukhar chôukoxeo

jerusalem.name: Jeruzalem
jerusalem.note: Mondirant dhôrlo, tacho bondi mhonn vatt suru zata.
events: Ek Roman nagrik mhonn, rakhonnen Sezariak dhaddtat

myra.name: Mira
myra.note: Tim Roma vôchpachea eka Aleksandriachea tarvar bôdôltat.

fairhaven.name: Bore Bandôr (Kret)
fairhaven.note: Tarvan vôchem ravounchi Pauluchi chetavnni aikonant.

crete.name: Kret
crete.note: Tacho suttka uprant, to dvip jõi to Igorzo nitt korunk Tituk soddta.
events: Dôr-eka gãvant vhôddil nemunk Tituk soddta

malta.name: Malta
malta.note: Vaddoll ani tarum-foddnnê modem-i, Devachi bhasavnni ghôtt ravta.
events: ‘Uttôr-udentti varo’ tarum fodta, tôriy sogllim 276 vanchtat
Eka sôrpan chablo, tôriy taka kãich zaina

puteoli.name: Puteoli
puteoli.note: Tim Italint pavtat ani bhavartan-bhav tankam mell'tat.

rome.name: Rom
rome.note: Bôri khobor nimannem razvôddkechea kallzak pavta — ek xevôtt nhoi, punn ek suru.
events: Don vôrsam ghôr-bondient, dhiradponnan Rajea porgottun
Hanga thaun to Bondxallentlim Potram boroita (Efez·Filip·Kolosai·Filemon)
Magir portun bondi zaun, 2 Timotei boroita ani hutatmo zata — “Hanvem borem zhuz zhuzlam, Hanvem dhanv sompoili”
